title: Cross-team sync & escalation log — 2028-05-02
content:
Attendees: Priya Kapoor (owner), Lena Ortiz, Marcus Liu, Ethan Wallace, Nadia Petrov, Rakesh Menon, invited: SRE on-call (Anya), Product (Khalid)

Meeting purpose: weekly cross-team leadership check to triage escalations, align on high-risk work, and capture action items for next 7 days. Focus this week: runtime cache regressions, Dedicated capacity planning for Q3 commit, and rollout gating for release-2028.05.

1) Quick heatmap (green/amber/red by domain, quick callouts)
- Serving runtime: amber -> regression in KV-prefix cache performance, higher p95 for long sequences (see PLAT-8423). Perf delta ~18% on 32k seqs. Root cause suspected kernel selection logic for quantized kernels.
- Dedicated: amber -> pool fillup predictions show 8% overcommit risk in us-west-2 for June. Finance commit modeling needs review.
- Private deployments: green -> onboarding of manufacturing customer progressing, minor networking config changes.
- Observability: amber -> tracing retention spike; queries slower when dashboard polyglot rendered.
- SRE/Incidents: red/amber -> two recent 15-30m degradations; one resolved (disk staging), one ongoing with follow-up.

2) Agenda items and notes
A. PLAT-8423: KV cache perf regression (Priya, Marcus, Ethan) - Notes: regression introduced in runtime selector change in PR #2147. Repro is intermittent; appears under mixed batch sizes and with Llama-variant quantized models. Bench harness shows consistent p95 increase when prefix cache hit ratio > 60%.
- Actions agreed:
  - Marcus to lead rollback candidate evaluation and run a reduced canary (small sample in us-east-1) by 2028-05-04 EOD (owner: Marcus Liu).
  - Ethan to instrument extra telemetry around kernel selection decisions (flags, chosen kernels, sequence length histogram) and push new metrics to the perf dashboard by 2028-05-03 COB (owner: Ethan Wallace).
  - If canary fails, we will trigger emergency rollback and notify customer success teams. Escalation path: Priya -> Nadia -> SRE on-call.
- Decision: temporary canary, no org-wide rollback yet.

B. Dedicated capacity commit risk (Rakesh, Lena) - Notes: current committed capacity proposal for Q3 assumes 20% growth. Forecast models now show potential 8% shortage in us-west-2 peak. Finance and Sales ask for mitigation options.
- Options discussed:
  - Short-term: enable burst pools with cross-region failover (cost: +12% estimated) — opt-in for top enterprise customers.
  - Medium-term: renegotiate commit or stagger capacity spin-up to avoid being fully provisioned at start of quarter.
- Actions:
  - Rakesh to run revised cost model and present 2 scenarios (burst vs stagger) by 2028-05-05 (owner: Rakesh Menon).
  - Lena to schedule a customer success pre-brief for top 5 impacted accounts by 2028-05-06 (owner: Lena Ortiz).

C. Release gating: release-2028.05 (Nadia, Platform leads) - Notes: Release has new autoscaler changes + observability retention tuning. Release blocker: one flaky test in e2e rollout pipeline due to timing race in health-checks.
- Decision: keep canary window extended to 48h for route /v1/generate while autoscaler is observed.
- Actions:
  - Nadia to own extended canary and compile rollback checklist by 2028-05-03 (owner: Nadia Petrov).
  - Release engineering to patch health-check race (PR in review) before org-wide rollout. If not merged by 2028-05-04, hold rollout.

D. Observability cost spike & dashboard slow queries (Lena, Observability team) - Notes: Traces and high-cardinality tags increased retention costs; dashboard rendering times impacted during peak.
- Action: create sampling strategy for traces older than 7 days and limit cardinality on service.tags; proposal due 2028-05-08 (owner: Observability eng lead, cc Lena).

E. SRE follow-up: recent incident postmortem (Anya on-call) - Notes: incident SRE-1291 root cause: staged disk high IO during nightly checkpoint, exposing a race in disk flush ordering. Postmortem draft in Jira.
- Action: Ops to add pre-check in deploy pipeline to validate disk IO buffers and enable soft limits during checkpoint window by 2028-05-09 (owner: SRE eng).

3) Cross-team risks and unresolved questions
- Model fallback policy clarity: who owns decision tree for fallback to smaller quantized variant? Product requested a documented policy for customer SLAs. Action: Priya + Product (Khalid) to draft decision tree and routing policy doc by 2028-05-10.
- Onboarding checklist for Private deployments is still missing the network egress test; leads to last-minute infra changes. Action: Platform infra to add egress check to onboarding playbook by 2028-05-07 (owner: Platform infra).

4) Action items (consolidated)
- Marcus Liu: Run rollback candidate canary for PLAT-8423 and report by 2028-05-04 EOD.
- Ethan Wallace: Add kernel-selection telemetry, push metrics to perf dashboard by 2028-05-03 COB.
- Rakesh Menon: Present capacity mitigation scenarios (burst vs stagger) by 2028-05-05.
- Lena Ortiz: Pre-brief top 5 customers about potential Dedicated burst plan by 2028-05-06.
- Nadia Petrov: Compile extended canary checklist and rollback playbook by 2028-05-03.
- Observability eng lead (TBD): Trace sampling strategy proposal by 2028-05-08.
- SRE eng: Deploy pipeline pre-check and soft limits by 2028-05-09.
- Priya Kapoor + Khalid (Product): Draft model fallback decision tree by 2028-05-10.
- Platform infra: Add network egress test to Private onboarding playbook by 2028-05-07.

5) Decisions summary (for comms)
- No org-wide rollback of runtime yet; limited canary to validate fixes.
- Extended canary for release-2028.05 for /v1/generate route (48h).
- Priority: fix kernel selection telemetry and capacity mitigation scenario assessment.

6) Notes to comms / customer success
- If canary indicates regression remains, prepare a short customer-facing note (1-pager) explaining: what happened, mitigation timeline, and temporary routing options. Draft owner: Lisa (CS lead). Deadline to have draft ready: 2028-05-04 morning.

7) Retro snippet (what went well / what to improve)
- Wins: faster cross-team sync cadence this sprint; quicker identification of PR #2147 as likely cause.
- Improve: need clearer pre-merge perf guardrails for kernel selection changes; propose automated bench in CI for long-sequence p95 baseline.

8) Next meeting (weekly cadence)
- Date/time: 2028-05-09 09:30 PT
- Proposed agenda items: PLAT-8423 canary result, Dedicated commit scenario, trace sampling decision, follow-up on release gating.

Appendix: quick links and diagnostic pointers - Perf dashboard: /dashboards/serve-runtime/p95-longseq - Canary instructions: run canary script under infra/canaries/run_kv_canary.sh with env CANARY_REGION=us-east-1

Unresolved quick notes (notes-to-self):
- Check if quantized kernel build flags were toggled in the nightly build on 2028-04-29.
- Verify that customer A has fallback enabled; if not, reach out to account technical lead.

End of notes.
